name: Osteoclast-macrophage lineage regulation via M-CSF signaling
rationale: All members concern proliferation, fusion and differentiation of macrophages and osteoclasts and the bone resorption they drive; the M-CSF/interleukin receptor signaling members separate it from the DAP12- and GM-CSF/differentiation-centred confusables.

name: Platelet activation and aggregation via soluble agonist receptors
rationale: All members describe platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation; the thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor members distinguish it from the adhesion/collagen and integrin-Rap1 confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members cover PCP protein localization and Wnt/PCP signaling and the convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis it drives; convergent extension in axis elongation and organogenesis is what the WNT5A/axial-mesoderm confusables lack.

name: Gi/z-coupled adenylate cyclase inhibition by alpha-2 adrenoceptors
rationale: All members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase and cyclic nucleotide signaling, chiefly its inhibition via Gi/Gz; the alpha-2 adrenergic receptor members distinguish it from the muscarinic/purinergic and PKA-activation confusables, while general cyclase inhibition separates it from the catecholamine-secretion confusables.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC-Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and activation through NK surface receptors engaging non-lymphoid cells; MHC class Ib presentation and NK inhibition separate it from the granzyme/defense and T-cell-proliferation confusables.

name: Embryonic face and limb mesenchymal morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of craniofacial (face, palate, nose, cranium) and limb/digit structures from mesenchyme; limbs distinguish it from the pharyngeal-gland confusables and palate/neurocranium from the ossification/suture confusable.

name: Fibroblast migration via integrin focal adhesion assembly
rationale: Members concern integrin production, fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly with SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodeling in migrating fibroblasts; focal adhesion assembly and collagen/TGF-beta signaling separate it from the syndecan/stress-fiber confusables, and fibroblast adhesion from the EMT/YAP confusable.

name: Skeletal muscle growth restraint including disuse atrophy
rationale: Members restrain muscle development, myoblast differentiation and satellite-cell output and cover atrophy, inactivity and SCF-ubiquitin catabolism; atrophy/inactivity separate it from the pro-myogenic confusable, and myoblast inhibition from the hypertrophy and contraction confusables.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination, D-loop and t-circle processing, capping and resolution of recombination intermediates; break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and mitotic intermediate resolution distinguish it from the telomere-packaging and repair confusables.

name: PKA activation by adenylate cyclase-derived cAMP
rationale: All members describe GPCR/forskolin-stimulated cAMP synthesis and PKA activation; cAMP biosynthesis distinguishes it from the cyclase-inhibitory and CREB/cAMP-catabolism confusables.

core: Vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi
name: COPI-mediated vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding and targeting between ER, ER exit sites and Golgi; the COPI coat members distinguish it from the COPII and tethering confusables.

name: Kidney development with nephron segment patterning
rationale: All members are kidney development from intermediate mesoderm through nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron; nephron tubule segment formation and proximal/distal patterning distinguish it from the ureteric bud induction confusables.

name: Endosome-plasma membrane recycling with vesicular cholesterol transport
rationale: Members concern endocytic and receptor recycling between endosomes, Golgi and plasma membrane; vesicular cholesterol transport separates it from the constitutive-secretion confusables and recycling to the surface from the retrograde endosome-to-Golgi confusable.

name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining terminal differentiation
rationale: Members describe transcriptional control of myeloid progenitors (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte programme) and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, unlike the confusables that promote differentiation or monocyte trafficking.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK cascade activation and feedback inactivation
rationale: All members concern RAF/MEK/ERK activation, including oncogenic RAF and RAS variants, and ERK dephosphorylation feedback; the RAF-to-ERK level distinguishes it from the RAS-GAP and SOS/p38 confusables.

qualifier: centred on vitamins K and C
name: Redox-active vitamin K and C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation, ascorbate metabolism and responses to vitamins E and K; vitamin C separates it from the vitamin D/E confusables and vitamin K carboxylation from the oxygen-transport confusable.

name: Dendritic cell chemokine production via cGAMP-STING sensing
rationale: Members regulate CCL5 and dendritic-cell cytokine production, including STAT6 and cGAS/STING inputs; cGAMP import and STING activation distinguish it from the CXCL/Th1 confusables and DC/CCL5 output from the IFN-beta/TREX1 confusable.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation including snRNP cap maturation
rationale: Members concern methylation and processing of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and snoRNA and their RNP assembly; snRNP assembly, snRNA transport and cap hypermethylation distinguish it from the pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

name: Stress-granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members describe RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation together with stress granule dynamics, PKR and arsenite response; stress granules and translational silencing distinguish it from the TTP/KSRP decay confusables.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation and maturation in joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy and cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis; joint morphogenesis separates it from the ossification/tendon confusables and cartilage condensation from the articular-homeostasis ones.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via K-ATP channel coupling
rationale: Members describe beta-cell insulin processing and secretion and its incretin, fatty-acid and neural regulation; K-ATP channel and glucokinase members distinguish it from the insulin-action/GLUT4 confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation with chain-specific deubiquitination
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly and degradation; DUB families and proteasome assembly distinguish it from the autophagy/ERAD and neddylation confusables.

name: Golgi organization and COPI traffic under Rab GTPase control
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure, COPI and intra-Golgi traffic and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation; Rab GEF and geranylgeranylation distinguish it from the TGN-lysosome and COPII confusables, and COPI traffic from the Ral confusable.

name: Glutamate-family amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolism terms whose specific content is proline synthesis and catabolism; proline distinguishes it from the glycine/serine and organic-acid confusables.

name: Retinoid metabolism with retinol uptake disorders
rationale: Members describe retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport; STRA6-related disease events distinguish it from the vitamin D and retinoid-response confusables, and retinoic acid biosynthesis from the visual-cycle confusable.

name: Telomere end protection against recombination and end joining
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and suppression of recombination, NHEJ and telomerase at chromosome ends; capping and recombination inhibition distinguish it from the telomere replication and telomerase-extension confusables.

name: Energy and redox nucleotide cofactor pool maintenance
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, phosphocreatine buffering and NAD(P) synthesis, salvage and transport; NAD/nicotinate, creatine and interconversion members each distinguish it from a confusable.

name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomere protection, C-strand synthesis, recombination and telomerase extension; Cajal-body trafficking of telomerase RNA distinguishes it from the DNA-repair confusables and telomere maintenance itself from the senescence confusable.

core: Inflammatory cytokine regulation by bacterial sensing
name: Bacterial-sensing inflammatory cytokine regulation via TLR2/4 and inflammasomes
rationale: Members concern detection of LPS and lipopeptides by TLR2/4, NLRP1/3 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing and regulation of inflammatory cytokine output; the inflammasome and LPS-detection members distinguish it from the TRIF/IL-10, monocyte and caspase-4/5 pyroptosis confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members describe beta-catenin/TCF signaling controlled by the AXIN-APC destruction complex; AXIN degradation and stabilization distinguish it from the target-gene repression and DVL/FZD confusables.
